description: A chunky cartoon box-body ambulance. At the front a short van cab with a sloped hood, a large windshield, one side window per door, a light grey side mirror on each door, a red light bar across the cab roof, a simple dark grille and two pale headlights on the front face and a full-width light grey front bumper. Behind the cab a tall square white patient box, taller and a little wider than the cab, with a small red marker lamp on each of its top corners; its two flanks are plain white walls; the two rear doors (each with a window and a handle) are on its back face. A broad horizontal red stripe runs along both flanks of the cab and the box and across the front of the cab. A full-width light grey rear bumper step. Four wheels with dark charcoal tyres and light grey hubs. Body white, stripe and light bar bright red, windows pale blue-grey, bumpers and hubs light grey, tyres dark charcoal.
proportions: at a width of 2.2 m across the patient box, the ambulance is 5.31 m long from the nose to the back of the box (the cab and hood 2.08 m, the box 3.23 m; the box is 1.47 times as long as it is wide) and 5.65 m bumper to bumper, and about 2.56 m tall from the ground to the box roof; the cab is 1.96 m wide (0.89 of the box), narrower and lower than the box; the red light bar is 1.51 m across and 0.26 m long at the FRONT edge of the cab roof; the mirror sticks start at the windshield's base corners and their tips stand 0.18 m beyond each box flank; the wheels are 0.8 m in diameter.
sides: the ambulance is symmetric left to right: the same stripe, door window and side mirror on both flanks, the light bar centred on the cab roof, the two rear doors side by side in the middle of the back face.
